# runtime-launch-option

The Runtime launch option: which runtime (`conversations/core`'s closed
`CONVERSATION_RUNTIMES` — tmux or sdk) a task's conversations start on, stored
per task in `tasks_ext_runtime` and read by `prepareConversation` when the
launch names none (`getTaskRuntime`). No row = the configured default
(`conversation-runtime.defaultRuntime`, Settings → Config). A fork or resume
keeps its source conversation's runtime whatever the task says. Not inherited
by tasks an agent files.

## Plugin reference
